subject: Dan Hicks
title: Dan Hicks death: NBC golf and Olympics voice dies at 64
answer: Dan Hicks, NBC Sports' lead golf play-by-play announcer and a longtime Olympics voice, died Wednesday, Nov. 11, 2026, at age 64. His wife, broadcaster Hannah Storm, said he died suddenly following an acute illness. He had worked at NBC for 34 years.
in_the_news: NBC Sports announced the death on Nov. 12, 2026, and tributes followed from the PGA Tour, the USGA, Golf Channel and U.S. Ski & Snowboard. Hicks was still working this fall as the play-by-play voice of Notre Dame football.
body:
Hicks, an Arizona native, began his career at CNN and joined NBC in 1992. He worked as a tower announcer on the network's golf coverage before becoming its lead golf play-by-play voice in 2000, a role he held for 26 years, much of it alongside analyst Johnny Miller. One of his best-known calls came at the 2008 U.S. Open, when Tiger Woods holed a putt on the final hole to force a playoff and Hicks said, "Expect anything different?"

He was just as familiar to Olympic viewers. Hicks called play-by-play at 15 Olympic Games, including a record eight in swimming, where he worked with analyst Rowdy Gaines. He called all 28 of Michael Phelps' Olympic medals from 2004 through 2016, including the eight golds in Beijing in 2008, and he handled Alpine skiing at the last four Winter Games. He also called NBA and NFL games and the French Open, and 2026 was his seventh season calling Notre Dame football.

NBC Sports executives called him an "extraordinary colleague, friend and person." Storm, who was married to Hicks for more than 30 years, said the family was heartbroken and called him "truly one of a kind." The couple has three daughters. NBC has not said who will call its remaining golf and Notre Dame broadcasts.

faq.a: His family said he died suddenly following an acute illness. No further details were released.
Hannah Storm, a longtime sports anchor at NBC and later ESPN. They were married for more than 30 years and have three daughters.

faq.q: What did Dan Hicks call for NBC?
faq.a: He was NBC's lead golf play-by-play voice from 2000, called 15 Olympic Games including eight in swimming, and was the voice of Notre Dame football.
